gloss: calling out three times; three cheers

definitions.gloss: calling out three times; giving three cheers
definitions.explanation: Shouting the same phrase three times in unison, above all in {万歳三唱|ばんざいさんしょう}, the three cheers of ばんざい given with raised arms at celebrations, election victories and send-offs.

examples.japanese: {万歳三唱|ばんざいさんしょう}！
⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{万歳|ばんざい}→万歳：04339_banzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三唱|さんしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone gave three cheers of banzai together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{万歳三唱|ばんざいさんしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}こった→起こる：01910_okoru⟧。
examples.english: When the election win was confirmed, the campaign office broke into three cheers of banzai.

notes:
Almost always met in {万歳三唱|ばんざいさんしょう}. One person leads (「⟦{万歳|ばんざい}→万歳：04339_banzai⟧！」) and everyone repeats it, arms raised, three times. It closes weddings, retirement parties, election nights and company events.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {万歳三唱|ばんざいさんしょう}: three cheers of banzai
- ⟦{万歳|ばんざい}→万歳：04339_banzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三唱|さんしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give three cheers of banzai
- {万歳三唱|ばんざいさんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音頭|おんど}→音頭：09782_ondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to lead the three cheers

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{万歳|ばんざい}→万歳：04339_banzai⟧: banzai, hurray
- ⟦{乾杯|かんぱい}→乾杯：00176_kanpai⟧: a toast, cheers
